definitions_and_hypotheses_checked: Connected regular second-countable smooth carriers, Borel measure, completeness and within-time regularity at zero.
Nonnegative curvature operator, full tensor norm convention, slice-wise bounds and nonflatness on every ancient slice.
Terminal spatial ball throughout backward cylinder; open-past ancient contract distinguished from closed-cylinder bounded-ancient theorem.
Positive prescribed scales tend to infinity without a monotonicity premise; chosen reference and scales retained.
Unnormalized reduced volume has Euclidean value (4 pi)^(n/2); AVR has no omega_n denominator.
Static potential initially C2, positive shrinker constant; boundedness and metric noncollapse required by admissible static data but not by surface compactness.
M18 does not already give the global bound needed for M20.
Universal constant chosen before the nonround three-dimensional solution; zero AVR has no nonround restriction.
M23 local scalar control, terminal extension, global bound, and backward nonflatness are distinct steps.
M24 uses fixed all-negative-time identifications and exact factors -2t on S2 and -4t on S3; the line factor is unscaled.

substantive_proof_trace.subject: Structure and prescribed sequences
substantive_proof_trace.mechanism: Curvature algebra, bounded ancient path Harnack for positivity, scalar and metric monotonicity, past bound, volume homothety; minimum provider applied on tau_i+1 and exact rescaling by reciprocal tau_i.

substantive_proof_trace.subject: Asymptotic carrier and equality
substantive_proof_trace.mechanism: Buffered complete limits, global relative diffeomorphisms, exactly compatible pullbacks on the first carrier and strict diagonal jets; connected local-oscillation bounds and a common Lipschitz potential extraction; Gaussian tails, constant actual mass, weak heat equality and local regularity, two potential identities, tensor defect and normalized Gaussian nonflatness.
substantive_proof_trace.depth: Main mechanism developed; energy-passage interface pending.

substantive_proof_trace.subject: Surface classification
substantive_proof_trace.mechanism: R exp(-f) constant and soliton energy give positive Ricci lower bound; compact coarea contradiction exceeds 8 pi; entropy derivative is variance minus Fisher information; Bochner, a completed square and spectral approximation prove nonincrease; compact smooth limit and homothety force zero entropy on original flow.

substantive_proof_trace.subject: Three-dimensional classification
substantive_proof_trace.mechanism: Stationary Ricci quotient maximum and coercive quartic; common normalized-gradient trajectory, compact level graphs and Gauss-Bonnet area contradiction; null distribution splitting; small-neck obstruction before static classification; integrate the time-dependent negative potential gradient to retain the original limit flow.
substantive_proof_trace.depth: Reaction and area contradictions developed; graph construction and neck flux quantitative input require further review.

substantive_proof_trace.subject: All-dimensional volume and universal kappa
substantive_proof_trace.mechanism: Minimizing-segment radial-square identity gives Hessian equal to metric; homothetic radial Laplacian equals twice Ricci and terminal null inequality forces flatness. Zero-ratio enclosed limit supplies an injective unit-umbilic Euclidean realization; d(normal)=d(immersion) gives a spherical diffeomorphism, angular comparison recovers chord isometry, and cone volume rigidity feeds dimension reduction. Separate universal-kappa proof uses a fixed earlier model region and generalized comparison with T=2, L0=10(1+exp(4)), and fixed model volume.
substantive_proof_trace.depth: Universal-kappa, radial differential rigidity, common cone charts, backward enclosing realization and all-dimensional link rigidity are developed. Local overlap, coverage and realization interfaces are reconciled; shared lower geometric estimates and volume-measure interfaces remain pending.

substantive_proof_trace.subject: Normalized compactness
substantive_proof_trace.mechanism: Positive volume gives finite-radius curvature control through a bounded positive-AVR auxiliary contradiction; choose exact half-Euclidean base radii tending to zero, rescale, retain 3/4 volume deficit at delta=min(1/2,log(3/2)/(81(B+1))), contradict flat all-scale injectivity; extend jets through zero; rule out shrinking spherical and projective necks via convex-level transport before global ancient packaging.
substantive_proof_trace.depth: Radius, deficit, Gronwall transport, graph differential and fixed-band diameter mechanisms developed. Smoothing and projective graph construction require independent depth review.

substantive_proof_trace.subject: Refined quotients
substantive_proof_trace.mechanism: Potential extrema normalize compact curvature; free orthogonal spherical deck group lies in SO(4); isometry at two times separates product tensors; kernels force factor maps; fixed-point-free sphere involution is antipodal; explicit equivariant map to punctured S3 gives the twisted projective quotient; local metric pullback yields local diffeomorphism and curvature transport.
substantive_proof_trace.depth: Developed argument preserving supplied carriers and maps, pending independent checking.
